title: Raw pure codegeneracy words and contextual codegeneracy replacements
statement: Let $\Delta$ be the category of nonempty finite ordinals and nondecreasing maps [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. For $a,b\geq0$, a raw pure codegeneracy word from $[a]$ to $[b]$ is a finite composable sequence of the nondecreasing surjections $\sigma_i^r:[r+1]\to[r]$ identifying $i$ and $i+1$, where $r\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq r$, including the empty word when $a=b$. Words are syntax and are not identified by their values. Concatenation places one composable sequence after another; evaluation sends the empty word to the identity and a sequence to its composite, read right to left. A forward step replaces, in any composable prefix and suffix, $\sigma_j^r\circ\sigma_i^{r+1}$ by $\sigma_i^r\circ\sigma_{j+1}^{r+1}$, where $r\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq j\leq r$. Two words are related if connected by finitely many such steps in either direction, including zero steps. Every intermediate word has the same endpoints and consists solely of codegeneracies; hence all its ordinal degrees lie between $b$ and $a$.
